desc:
🎲 Welcome to Korean Board Game Cafe! 

All of your favorite board games are now available here!

From Woncard to Holimolly and Kubitail!
You don't have to search for them separately - all kinds of board games are gathered in one place.
Compete with your friends, showcase your skills with new players, and set your own winning streak record!

🥇 Challenge the consecutive win record! 
Prove your skills by winning.
How many consecutive wins can he achieve?

☕ Order drinks and food and earn experience points! 
For a board game cafe, delicious food and drinks are a must!
Eat, drink, gain experience, and enjoy the game to grow even more!

🪑 Play together at the table of your choice! 
- 2-person table - A face-off between two friends!
- 4-person table - An intense game with friends!
- 8-person table - Large-scale games for more people!

You can enjoy various games at the board game cafe, so feel free to play there!

Now, sit down. Today's winner might just be you!
